Hey, I’m Max! 👋🏻

I’ve dropped out of my undergraduate degree at MIT to build Ozone, the world’s first cloud-powered video editor. I’m passionate about filmmaking, cloud tech and space.

launches.title: Ozone: The fastest way to edit videos with AI!
launches.tagline: Create engaging videos in seconds using our first-of-its-kind creative tool in the browser. Ozone unites AI, pro video editing tools, and real-time collaboration.
launches.body:
**tl;dr:** create social media, marketing, or product videos faster than ever before with AI. Sign up now and move all of your content workflows to Ozone in minutes.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81725&key=user_uploads/693933/d87084c8-86ff-48c6-b975-04f42facd54b)

—

Hey YC!

[Ozone](https://ozone.pro/) is the fastest way to edit video with the help of AI. After nearly 3 years of building and 6 months of testing, Ozone is finally coming out of its beta phase. With it, you can:

✨ **Generate AI media** like videos, images, sound effects, music, and speech directly within our editor.

🎥 **Edit like a pro** by removing silences, generating captions, animating and keyframing your videos, color grade, crop — leverage pro features without needing to be a pro!

🏞️ **Store and organize all your media** in one unified place in the cloud.

👥  **Share and collaborate** on your video projects with your team by leaving comments, approving videos, and making final edits in real time.

\
**What can I use Ozone for**

📱Short-form product or marketing videos on TikTok, IG Reels, or YouTube Shorts

🪄Generative AI stock and art

🎥 YouTube company content, podcasts and updates

\
**Get access for your team**\
\
Send me an email at [hello@ozone.pro,](mailto:max@ozone.pro) and we’ll set up an onboarding call with your team! If you’d like to try Ozone individually, sign up [**here**](https://app.ozone.tech/register) and get set up in minutes. Feedback is much appreciated!
